name: Peter Akwaboah

career.title: Operations and technology leadership roles, incl. Asia Pacific COO for Operations, Technology and Corporate Services
Managing Director; COO for Operations, then COO for Technology and Head of Innovation
Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer

background_rationale: Trained as a civil engineer and spent three decades in operations and technology roles at IBM, KPMG, Deutsche Bank, RBS and Morgan Stanley before becoming Fannie Mae's COO.

notable.summary: Was named acting CEO after Priscilla Almodovar's departure, while keeping his COO role, as the board began a search for a permanent CEO and promoted John Roscoe and Brandon Hamara to co-presidents.
Reporting 2025 net income of $14.4 billion and a record net worth of $109 billion, Akwaboah said the company had strong momentum going into 2026.

Hosting the second-quarter 2026 results webcast, Akwaboah reported $4 billion in quarterly net income and said Fannie Mae provided $125 billion in liquidity to the mortgage market, helping about 417,000 households.

personal_story.hook: Born in the UK and raised in Ghana, a civil engineering graduate rose through bank operations to lead Fannie Mae.
personal_story.summary: Akwaboah was born in the United Kingdom, brought to Ghana at a young age, and completed secondary school there, where he was a standout student athlete, before rejoining his family in the UK as a teenager. He studied civil engineering at the University of Birmingham and began his career in engineering and technology at IBM before moving into financial services. Over three decades he held operations and technology roles at KPMG, Deutsche Bank, Royal Bank of Scotland and Morgan Stanley, where he became COO for technology and head of innovation and helped the firm co-lead a bond sale for Ghana's government. He joined Fannie Mae as COO in May 2024 and was named acting CEO in October 2025.
